title: The People Element: Ecosystems, Change, Stakeholders and Culture

header.html: Define organizational ecosystem, project ecosystem, change management, stakeholder, culture, collaboration and co-creation, leadership and management; explain the difference between people within the project and people affected by the project; explain change management and why it matters
the official PRINCE2 7 Foundation syllabus (PeopleCert), learning outcome 3

html:
1Why a people element

PRINCE2 7 added people as a full element because projects succeed or fail through people. The method must be applied by, and for, real people with different views, cultures and interests.

2Ecosystems

Term Meaning
Organizational ecosystem The wider organization(s) around the project: structure, culture, other projects and programmes, and the people and groups it affects
Project ecosystem The people and groups connected to the project itself: the project management team and the stakeholders around it

People within the project and people affected by it

Group Examples
People within the project The project management team: board members, project manager, team managers, project assurance and support
People affected by the project Users, operations staff, customers, other teams: those who change how they work or use the result
Exam tip

. Within = the project management team. Affected = everyone who feels the change. A stakeholder can be either.

3Change, stakeholders and culture

Term Meaning
Change management Helping people move from the current way of working to the new one, and keeping the benefits
Stakeholder Anyone who can affect, is affected by, or believes they are affected by the project
Culture The shared values, attitudes and behaviors of a group

Why change management matters: a project can deliver the product on time and still fail if people do not adopt it. The change management approach (part of the PID) says how the project will support people through the change.

Stakeholder engagement

Identify stakeholders, analyze their interest and influence, plan how to engage them, engage and review. Engagement is continuous, not a one-off. The communication management approach (Module 4) records the plan.

4Collaboration, co-creation, leadership and management

Term Meaning
Collaboration People working together toward shared objectives
Co-creation Involving users and stakeholders in building the solution with the team
Leadership Inspiring and guiding people toward a vision; influence
Management Planning, organizing, controlling and delivering within agreed limits
Exam tip

. Leadership = direction and inspiration (people). Management = planning and control (work). A good project manager needs both.

Exam tip

. Stakeholder is the widest word: it covers people within the project and people affected by it, and even those who only believe they are affected.

5Exam Q&A

5.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Warehouse staff will have to change how they scan items after the project delivers a new system. What are they in relation to the project?

  • APeople within the project
  • BPeople affected by the project
  • CThe project board
  • DProject assurance
Show the answer

Answer: B. They are affected by the project.

S2Which statements are CORRECT? (1) A stakeholder can affect the project. (2) A stakeholder can be affected by the project. (3) Only the project board members are stakeholders. (4) Stakeholders are only people inside the project team.

  • A3 and 4
  • B1 and 2
  • C2 and 3
  • D1 and 4
Show the answer

Answer: B. A stakeholder can affect, or be affected by, the project.

S3Identify the missing word. [ ? ] describes the shared values, attitudes and behaviors of a group.

  • AScope
  • BCulture
  • CA tolerance
  • DA stage
Show the answer

Answer: B. That is culture.

S4A project delivered a new tool on time, but staff keep using the old one. Which people concept was neglected?

  • AQuality control
  • BStage planning
  • CChange management
  • DRisk transfer
Show the answer

Answer: C. Helping people adopt the change is change management.

S5Which pair correctly matches leadership and management?

  • ALeadership is planning and control; management is inspiration
  • BBoth mean exactly the same thing
  • CLeadership belongs to the team only
  • DLeadership is inspiring and guiding people; management is planning and controlling the work
Show the answer

Answer: D. Leadership inspires; management plans and controls.

S6Where is the plan for supporting people through the change recorded?

  • AIn the change management approach, part of the PID
  • BIn the end stage report
  • CIn the lessons log
  • DIn the work package
Show the answer

Answer: A. The change management approach is part of the PID.

5.2 Recall questions

R1Define a stakeholder.

Show the answer

Anyone who can affect, is affected by, or believes they are affected by the project.

R2What is the project ecosystem?

Show the answer

The people and groups connected to the project itself.

R3What is change management?

Show the answer

Helping people move from the current way of working to the new one and keeping the benefits.

R4Define culture.

Show the answer

The shared values, attitudes and behaviors of a group.

R5What is co-creation?

Show the answer

Involving users and stakeholders in building the solution with the team.

R6Which management product records how the project will support change?

Show the answer

The change management approach (in the PID).

6Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Ecosystems organizational (wider organization) and project (people connected to the project)
Within / affected project management team / everyone who feels the change
Stakeholder can affect, be affected, or believe they are affected
Change management move people to the new way; PID approach
Leadership / management inspire people / plan and control work
